changes.note: Support for Node 14 removed; Node 14 reached EOL in February 2023. Upgrade to at least Node 16 before upgrading this package.
The domain and storefrontAccessToken fields are deprecated in favour of the same session other clients use.
The Shopify type now receives the config as its first generic and infers restResources from it.
Removed support for the privateMetafieldNamespaces field in webhooks.
When calling shopifyApi, adminApiAccessToken is now mandatory when isCustomStoreApp is true. It has logged an error since v7.1.0 and now throws.
